messages.name: ES_NOOP
messages.description: ES no-op; increments ES command counter and emits an info event.

messages.name: ES_RESET_COUNTERS
messages.description: Reset ES command and error counters.

messages.name: ES_CLEAR_SYS_LOG
messages.description: Clear the ES system log.

messages.name: ES_WRITE_SYS_LOG
messages.description: Write the ES system log to a file (OSAL path; /ram/x maps to /dev/shm/osal:RAM/x on the native build; empty string selects the default /ram/cfe_es_syslog.log).

fields.name: FileName
fields.description: Full path and file name to write; NUL-padded

messages.name: ES_SEND_HK
messages.description: Request one ES housekeeping packet (normally sent by SCH_LAB every 4.0 s).

messages.name: ES_HK
messages.description: cFE Executive Services housekeeping.

fields.name: SysLogBytesUsed
fields.description: Bytes used in the system log

fields.name: SysLogSize
fields.description: Total size of the system log

fields.name: ERLogEntries
fields.description: ER log entries made since power on

fields.name: RegisteredTasks
fields.description: Tasks (main and child) registered with ES

fields.name: ProcessorResets
fields.description: Processor resets since last power on

fields.name: MaxProcessorResets
fields.description: Max processor resets before a power-on reset

fields.name: PerfFilterMask
fields.description: Performance filter masks (4 x uint32 little-endian)

fields.name: PerfTriggerMask
fields.description: Performance trigger masks (4 x uint32 little-endian)

fields.name: PerfDataStart
fields.description: First stored entry in the performance log

fields.name: PerfDataEnd
fields.description: Last stored entry in the performance log

fields.name: PerfDataCount
fields.description: Entries put into the performance log

fields.name: PerfDataToWrite
fields.description: Entries left to write to the dump file

fields.name: HeapBytesFree
fields.description: Free bytes in the OS heap

fields.name: HeapBlocksFree
fields.description: Free blocks in the OS heap

messages.name: EVS_NOOP
messages.description: EVS no-op; increments the EVS command counter and emits an info event.

messages.name: EVS_RESET_COUNTERS
messages.description: Reset EVS command and error counters.

messages.name: EVS_SEND_HK
messages.description: Request one EVS housekeeping packet (normally sent by SCH_LAB every 4.2 s).

messages.name: EVS_HK
messages.description: cFE Event Services housekeeping (per-app event counters are left as the raw 16 x 8 byte AppData table).

fields.name: AppData
fields.description: CFE_MISSION_ES_MAX_APPLICATIONS (16) x 8-byte records: u32 AppID, u16 MessageSentCounter, u8 EnableStatus, u8 MessageSquelchedCounter

messages.name: EVS_LONG_EVENT
messages.description: cFE long-format event: who, what, how severe, and the message text.

fields.name: AppName
fields.description: Name of the app that sent the event; NUL-padded (CFE_MISSION_MAX_API_LEN = 20)

messages.name: EVS_SHORT_EVENT
messages.description: cFE short-format event: identification only, no text.

fields.name: AppName
fields.description: Name of the app that sent the event; NUL-padded (CFE_MISSION_MAX_API_LEN = 20)

messages.name: TIME_NOOP
messages.description: TIME no-op; increments TIME command counter.

messages.name: TIME_RESET_COUNTERS
messages.description: Reset TIME command and error counters (and tone/1Hz counters).

messages.name: TIME_SEND_DIAGNOSTIC
messages.description: Request one TIME diagnostic packet (TIME_DIAG).

messages.name: TIME_SET_STATE
messages.description: Force the clock state (VALID or FLYWHEEL).

messages.name: TIME_SET_TIME
messages.description: Set spacecraft time (server only); microseconds must be < 1000000.

messages.name: TIME_SET_MET
messages.description: Set MET (server only); microseconds must be < 1000000.

messages.name: TIME_SET_STCF
messages.description: Set the spacecraft time correction factor (server only); microseconds must be < 1000000.

messages.name: TIME_SET_LEAP_SECONDS
messages.description: Set leap seconds (server only).

messages.name: TIME_ADD_ADJUST
messages.description: Add a one-time adjustment to STCF (server only).

messages.name: TIME_SUB_ADJUST
messages.description: Subtract a one-time adjustment from STCF (server only).

messages.name: TIME_SEND_HK
messages.description: Request one TIME housekeeping packet (normally sent by SCH_LAB every 4.4 s).

messages.name: TIME_HK
messages.description: cFE Time Services housekeeping.

fields.name: ClockStateFlags
fields.description: Clock state flag bits (CLKSET 0x8000, FLYING 0x4000, SRCINT 0x2000, SIGPRI 0x1000, SRVFLY 0x0800, CMDFLY 0x0400, ADDADJ 0x0200, ADD1HZ 0x0100, ADDTCL 0x0080, SERVER 0x0040, GDTONE 0x0020, REFERR 0x0010)

fields.name: ClockStateAPI
fields.description: Clock state as seen through the API

fields.name: AdjustmentFactor_Seconds
fields.description: Current adjustment factor (1 Hz STCF adjustment on a server; tone delay on a client) - seconds

fields.name: AdjustmentFactor_Subseconds
fields.description: Current adjustment factor (1 Hz STCF adjustment on a server; tone delay on a client) - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

messages.name: TIME_DIAG
messages.description: cFE Time Services diagnostics.

fields.name: AtToneMET_Seconds
fields.description: MET at time of tone - seconds

fields.name: AtToneMET_Subseconds
fields.description: MET at time of tone - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: AtToneSTCF_Seconds
fields.description: STCF at time of tone - seconds

fields.name: AtToneSTCF_Subseconds
fields.description: STCF at time of tone - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: AtToneDelay_Seconds
fields.description: Adjustment for slow tone detection - seconds

fields.name: AtToneDelay_Subseconds
fields.description: Adjustment for slow tone detection - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: AtToneLatch_Seconds
fields.description: Local clock latched at time of tone - seconds

fields.name: AtToneLatch_Subseconds
fields.description: Local clock latched at time of tone - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: AtToneLeapSeconds
fields.description: Leap seconds at time of tone

fields.name: ClockStateAPI
fields.description: Clock state as seen through the API

fields.name: TimeSinceTone_Seconds
fields.description: Time elapsed since the tone - seconds

fields.name: TimeSinceTone_Subseconds
fields.description: Time elapsed since the tone - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: CurrentLatch_Subseconds
fields.description: Local clock latched now - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: OneTimeAdjust_Subseconds
fields.description: Previous one-time STCF adjustment - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: OneHzAdjust_Subseconds
fields.description: Current 1 Hz STCF adjustment - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: ToneSignalLatch_Seconds
fields.description: Local clock at most recent tone signal - seconds

fields.name: ToneSignalLatch_Subseconds
fields.description: Local clock at most recent tone signal - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: ToneDataLatch_Seconds
fields.description: Local clock at arrival of tone data - seconds

fields.name: ToneDataLatch_Subseconds
fields.description: Local clock at arrival of tone data - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: VersionCounter
fields.description: Count of modifications to time-at-tone reference data

fields.name: MaxLocalClock_Seconds
fields.description: Max local clock value before rollover - seconds

fields.name: MaxLocalClock_Subseconds
fields.description: Max local clock value before rollover - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: DataStoreStatus
fields.description: Data store status (preserved across processor reset)

messages.name: SB_SEND_HK
messages.description: Request one SB housekeeping packet (normally sent by SCH_LAB every 4.6 s).

messages.name: SB_HK
messages.description: cFE Software Bus housekeeping.

fields.name: GetPipeIdByNameErrorCounter
fields.description: Get pipe id by name errors

messages.name: TBL_SEND_HK
messages.description: Request one TBL housekeeping packet (normally sent by SCH_LAB every 4.8 s).

messages.name: TBL_HK
messages.description: cFE Table Services housekeeping.

fields.name: LastValCrc
fields.description: Data integrity value of the last validated table

fields.name: LastValStatus
fields.description: Status returned by the last validation

fields.name: LastValTableName
fields.description: Name of the last validated table

fields.name: LastUpdateTime_Seconds
fields.description: Time of last table update - seconds

fields.name: LastUpdateTime_Subseconds
fields.description: Time of last table update - subseconds (LSB = 2^-32 s)

fields.name: LastUpdatedTable
fields.description: Name of the last updated table

fields.name: LastFileLoaded
fields.description: Path of the last table file loaded

fields.name: LastFileDumped
fields.description: Path of the last file dumped to

fields.name: LastTableLoaded
fields.description: Name of the last table loaded

messages.name: SAMPLE_APP_NOOP
messages.description: SAMPLE_APP no-op; increments its command counter.

messages.name: SAMPLE_APP_RESET_COUNTERS
messages.description: Reset SAMPLE_APP command and error counters.

messages.name: SAMPLE_APP_PROCESS
messages.description: Process the example table via sample_lib; increments the command counter.

messages.name: SAMPLE_APP_DISPLAY_PARAM
messages.description: Echo the arguments in an info event; increments the command counter.

messages.name: SAMPLE_APP_SEND_HK
messages.description: Request one SAMPLE_APP housekeeping packet (normally sent by SCH_LAB every 5.4 s). Counters in HK are copied only on this request.

messages.name: SAMPLE_APP_HK
messages.description: SAMPLE_APP housekeeping.

messages.name: CI_LAB_NOOP
messages.description: CI_LAB no-op; increments its command counter.

messages.name: CI_LAB_RESET_COUNTERS
messages.description: Reset CI_LAB command, error, ingest-packet and ingest-error counters.

messages.name: CI_LAB_SEND_HK
messages.description: Request one CI_LAB housekeeping packet (normally sent by SCH_LAB every 5.0 s).

messages.name: CI_LAB_HK
messages.description: CI_LAB housekeeping.

fields.name: EnableChecksums
fields.description: Declared in the packet but never written by CI_LAB (always 0)

fields.name: IngestPackets
fields.description: Datagrams accepted and forwarded to the software bus

fields.name: IngestErrors
fields.description: Datagrams dropped (too short, or header length larger than datagram)

messages.name: TO_LAB_NOOP
messages.description: TO_LAB no-op; increments its command counter. Length is not verified.

messages.name: TO_LAB_RESET_STATUS
messages.description: Reset TO_LAB command and error counters.

messages.name: TO_LAB_ADD_PKT
messages.description: Subscribe the downlink pipe to a message ID. Payload is 8 bytes (1 trailing pad byte).

fields.name: Stream
fields.description: Message ID (full 16-bit stream ID value) to forward

fields.name: BufLimit
fields.description: Max buffered messages of this ID (must be < pipe depth)

messages.name: TO_LAB_SEND_DATA_TYPES
messages.description: Emit one TO_LAB_DATA_TYPES packet.

messages.name: TO_LAB_REMOVE_PKT
messages.description: Unsubscribe the downlink pipe from a message ID.

messages.name: TO_LAB_REMOVE_ALL_PKT
messages.description: Unsubscribe the downlink pipe from every message ID.

messages.name: TO_LAB_ENABLE_OUTPUT
messages.description: Start telemetry output: TO_LAB sends UDP datagrams to dest_IP port 2234 (cpu1).

fields.name: dest_IP
fields.description: Destination IPv4 address as dotted text, NUL-padded

messages.name: TO_LAB_SEND_HK
messages.description: Request one TO_LAB housekeeping packet (normally sent by SCH_LAB every 5.2 s).

messages.name: TO_LAB_HK
messages.description: TO_LAB housekeeping.

messages.name: TO_LAB_DATA_TYPES
messages.description: TO_LAB data-types test packet with fixed known values (after TO_LAB_SEND_DATA_TYPES). Offsets include natural alignment padding.

messages.name: IB_TEST_NOOP
messages.description: ironbird's test app (tools/cfs/apps/ib_test): no operation

messages.name: IB_TEST_RESET_COUNTERS
messages.description: ironbird's test app: reset the command counters

messages.name: IB_TEST_SET_DATA
messages.description: ironbird's test app: store a counted array and a tail string, then publish IB_TEST_VAR (variable length)

fields.name: Text
fields.description: Tail string: the rest of the packet

messages.name: IB_TEST_SEND_VAR
messages.description: ironbird's test app: publish IB_TEST_VAR with the stored data

messages.name: IB_TEST_SEND_HK
messages.description: Request one IB_TEST housekeeping packet

messages.name: IB_TEST_HK
messages.description: ironbird's test app housekeeping

messages.name: IB_TEST_VAR
messages.description: ironbird's test app: the stored counted array and tail string (variable length)

fields.name: Text
fields.description: Tail string: the rest of the packet
